propositions: Rebar must support provider-native authentication (Anthropic, OpenAI, boto3, Gerrit, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, Jira) across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and AWS-hosted environments without a universal secret broker or credential store that weakens SDK-native refresh and rotation.

Operation snapshots must remain non-secret and immutable; only provider-specific non-serializable static-auth containers using Pydantic SecretStr/SecretBytes are allowed for unavoidable static credentials, revealed only inside their owning adapter.

Deployment resolves all external secret stores (SSM, keyrings, vaults) before process startup; Rebar accepts either REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH (preferred file) or multiline REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY environment variable and materializes a 0600 runtime copy without application-owned retrieval, polling, or hot-reload.

Trusted same-capability child processes inherit ambient environment for compatibility; Rebar materializes static credentials only for owning children, removes exact Rebar-declared secret names from unrelated siblings, and never mutates global os.environ.

Static credential rotation for long-running processes requires restart or redeploy; short-lived CLI processes receive current startup environment; native temporary/workload credentials remain SDK-owned and may refresh in-process.
